## Summary of Analysis

In this assignment, I explored different ways to improve the Comp110 course moving forward. In order to do this, I looked at survey data that was taken from the students in the course. Using functions created both in class and by myself. I looked at the effectiveness of office hours and the frequency in which students used them. I created visualizations to show these data points and concluded that utilizing zoom office hours could be beneficial for multiple stakeholders of the class.

## Final Conclusions

Based on the results, I believe that my data mostly supports my idea of impementing zoom or online office hours on Sundays or other days or times that might be more convenient for TAs and students. Looking at the data for office hour visits, it is clear that many students feel the need to attend office hours in order to complete assignments. While their are many responses saying that no office hour visits are necessary, I am assuming that some of those students have never attended, and could better understand concepts if they did despite not needing help to complete the work. On the other hand, the data for office hours effectiveness shows that a large portion of students found office hours extremely helpful. I also saw a good number of empty values, meaning that a lot of students had never attended office hours. This might change if office hours were more convenient on weekends or in the evenings. Additional data that might help confirm this hypothesis would involve surveying if students would prefer to have office hours on zoom at certain times. This could also allow TAs to cater to preferences on which days would be busier or better suited for an online format. It is possible that this could negatively affect both TAs and students as some issues that students have are probably better taught in an in person setting. There also may be rules on how office hours can be held that would affect the abilty for this to be implemented.
